# Tests known to fail on Windows. Each line names the child of epic
# links-windows-qr8l that owns the failure. nightly.yml's `windows` job skips
# exactly these, so a Windows-only failure in any other test turns the lane
# red. The ticket that fixes a failure deletes its lines, and the epic is done
# when no lines remain.
#
# <ticket> <package> <top-level test, or * for a package whose tests do not
# compile on Windows>
